description: Shell robustness: fix backup.sh so it survives spaces, tabs, newlines, glob characters, unicode and leading-dash file names, implements the documented exit codes and manifest contract, skips FIFOs, warns about files that vanish mid-run, traps its temp dir on EXIT and stays idempotent; check.py drives it against generated trees and failure modes.

criteria: backup.sh was rewritten to satisfy docs/backup-spec.md for real (quoting, find -print0, safe rm/cp with --, manifest, exit codes 0/1/2, trap on EXIT), passes check.py on the tricky trees and failure modes, and nothing except backup.sh changed.
